title: One measured capability, as accepted by PATCH /api/v1/model-profiles/{id}
description: Poundlock owns this file. scripts/toolkit-capabilities.py validates its output against it, and the Rust struct is tested against it. Changing the shape means changing this file, the struct and the script together.

result_sha256.description: One hash per measurement, not per run: a paired investigation is one verdict from two documents. run_ids carries the individual runs.

recorded_at.description: Server-controlled. Any client-supplied value is overwritten.

allOf.description: Toolkit-sourced evidence must carry its provenance. `identity_sha256` is deliberately absent from this list: a paired measurement whose two runs disagree on identity omits it, and that case is already reported as insufficient.
